info.name: Book My Show - Local GET learning
info.description: Import and select No environment. Send requests individually in numbered order. All requests are GETs against the deployed local gateway; no fixtures, holds or payments are created. List requests save the first returned ID into collection variables. Empty lists are valid: dependent detail requests require an existing ID. Start with requests 2 and 3 for the saved API 3 lesson.

request.description: Observe status and instance. Repeated sends through HAProxy can reach different replicas. For database-aware readiness, use /actuator/health/readiness.

item.name: 2 - List events and save an ID

request.description: Learn pagination and JSON arrays. Saves the first event ID for request 3; an empty array means no retained events exist.
Send request 2 first. Compare this single object with the list response. Follow BookingController.event -> BookingService.event -> SELECT by primary key.
Read the movie slate. Movie catalog data is separate from the generic event APIs above.

item.name: 5 - Browse Mumbai cinemas and save an ID

request.description: Learn query filtering. Saves the first multiplex ID and clears any previously selected show. Change the city query parameter to explore another city.

item.name: 6 - List tomorrow's shows and save an ID

request.description: Send request 5 first. Defaults the date to tomorrow in India; set learningShowDate to override it (YYYY-MM-DD, within today..today+3). Saves the first show ID. An empty result may mean the rolling scheduler has not filled that cinema/date yet.
Send request 6 first. Read seatNumber, category, priceMinor and availability. Prices are in paise. Reading availability does not reserve seats.
